blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Seventy four bird species have been documented in the first-ever bird race and photo competition at the Las Piñas-Parañaque Wetland Park (LPPWP) last month. The LPPWP, in a statement on Sunday, Nov. 8, said the “Ibong Dayo: Individual Bird Race and Photo Competition” from Oct. 17 to 19 was held to mark World Migratory Bird Day.
